out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CHEMICAL BOTTLES STORED ON TOP OF SOY SAUCE AND ON A SHELF WITH FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CHEMICALS RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: OBSERVED WORKING CONTAINERS OF CHEMICALS WITHOUT LABELS IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CHEMICALS LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required for ROP
violations.observation: A HACCP Plan was not submitted prior to engaging in VACUUM PACKAGING RAW BEEF “RIB FINGERS”. PIC STATED IT IS VACUUM SEALED AND KEPT FOR ~7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: VACUUM PACKAGED MEAT ONSITE WAS MADE ON SUNDAY AND WILL BE USED BY THE END OF THE DAY TODAY. PIC RE- EDUCATED AND IS AWARE HE CAN ONLY KEEP THESE VACUUM PACKAGED MEATS FOR 48HRS WHILE REFRIGERATED. HE STATED HE WILL NOT BE VACUUM PACKAGING ANYMORE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Corn-cheese, kimchi, and other foods, inside the a wall-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor inside the walk-in Refrigerator and in a few dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the base of the back door to the kitchen is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: A variety of foods prep on site and held over 24 hours, do not have date marking top show prep or use-by-dates.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Unmarked spray bottles containing toxic cleaning solutions are not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A large number of unmarked squeeze bottles and containers with foods that are not easy to identify, were not labeled to show contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Weren’t wiping towels were observed stored on counter-tops and work tables, and not soaked in the sanitizing solutions after each use, as required.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. The chlorine sanitizer was noted to be less than 50 ppm, when tested.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. Do not use this m,achieve until it is fixed and is able to properly sanitize utensils and equipment.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Observed no employee health policy in place that was signed by every staff member on shift during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PIC printed new employee health policies and had every staff member sign them during inspection

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: EHS observed the handwashing sink next to the mechanical ware washing unit being used to store decanters of ice water.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC had employee remove decanters from the handwashing sink. Qui Korean BBQ & Bar (Inspection Date: 02/14/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: EHS observed rice being held for longer than 4 hours at 104F and 111F in a hot holding cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC disposed of rice that was being held at improper temperatures

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: EHS observed no disclosure statement on the menu for the items on the menu that may be served raw or undercooked.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC showed draft re-print for menu that included a disclosure statement. EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: EHS observed personal care items being stored throughout the Kitchen area above food prep surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC moved personal items to employee storage so they were away from food contact surfaces.

violations.observation: EHS observed the mechanical chemical sanitizing ware washing machine was not being operated per data plate ( concentration of sanitizer was at 0 ppm)

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floor to Wall Junctures Coved, Closed
violations.observation: EHS observed hole in the floor to wall juncture int he rear of the kitchen next to the employee bathroom
violations.corrective_action: If cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no more than 1 millimeter. PIC agreed to seal up holes in the wall near the employee bathroom by next inspection.
